claim.text: Attributed Knight Frank commentary (published 7 Oct 2026) argues London office development is not keeping pace with occupier demand for the type of space now required, citing viability pressures and macroeconomic caution; it carries no measurement period.
claim.headline: Knight Frank commentary: development lagging demand

claim.text: Savills reported Central London Q2 2026 take-up of 2.4 million sq ft across 192 transactions, up 0.2 million sq ft (9.1%) on Q1 2026's 2.2 million sq ft.
claim.headline: Central London Q2 take-up 2.4m sq ft

claim.text: Savills reported Central London vacancy fell 0.2 percentage points to 7.2% at end-Q2 2026 from 7.4% at end-Q1 2026; the City rate was unchanged at 7.0%.
claim.headline: Central London vacancy 7.2% at end-Q2 2026

claim.text: The Bank of England reported UK CPI inflation increased to 3.1% in August 2026.
claim.headline: UK CPI 3.1% in August 2026

claim.text: GLA Economics reported London real GVA grew 0.3% in 2023, against 0.4% for the UK, based on the most recent ONS release it cited.
claim.headline: GLA: London real GVA 0.3% in 2023

limitations: No weekly London office indicator exists in the reviewed evidence; all cited market measurements are monthly, quarterly or half-yearly and cannot support week-over-week statements.
Availability is a distinct measure from vacancy and no reviewed availability series was retrieved, so availability is excluded rather than inferred from vacancy.
Central London aggregates do not establish whole-London coverage; Midtown itself remains unmeasured and wider-London evidence covers selected districts only.
Canary Wharf has qualitative evidence only, with no normalized area measurements; scheme-level announcements are not area metrics.
UK and Great Britain macro, rates and hybrid-work data are contextual and are not London office measurements.

availability: No reviewed availability-rate series was retrieved; availability is excluded rather than inferred from vacancy.
midtown_fringe: Retained quantitative history is City Fringe only; Midtown itself remains unmeasured.
wider_london: Retained evidence covers selected districts (Hammersmith, VNEB, Stratford) and does not represent all wider London.
canary_wharf: Qualitative evidence only; no normalized Canary Wharf area measurements.
hybrid: Only Great Britain-wide survey evidence from early 2025; no London-specific current hybrid measurement.
rates: UK-wide policy rate only; no London office financing-cost measurement.
